Gus is immediately after Cara, and the Finn–Gus gap of exactly one person cannot sit on Cara’s other side, because that would put Finn only one slot from Cara. So Finn is exactly three after Cara: the block is Cara, Gus, then Finn two later.

Ann, Hana, and Ivo must all precede Cara, and Elif must be at least three after Cara. The only block that fits is Cara in 5, Gus in 6, Finn in 8. Elif then has to be 9, which forces Dev into 7. Ann is two before Ivo, Ann is before Hana, and Ben is at least three after Ann, so the first four slots are Ann, Hana, Ivo, Ben. Cara in 4 leaves Gus only two from Ivo, and Cara in 6 leaves Elif nowhere to sit.
